newsitem.title: USA: Alpharma sees 25 pct annual earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Alpharma sees 25 pct annual earnings growth.

text.p: Alpharma Inc chief executive Eina Sissener told shareholders at its annual meeting on Wednesday that the company should be able to achieve double digit revenue growth and increase earnings at a minimum of 25 percent annually from its 1997 base.
First Call 1997 consensus estimates for the company are $0.59 per share.
Sissner added that "As the largest single shareholder, I will personally be very disappointed if we can only earn the current analyst consensus estimate for 1997."

Sissener said facility consolidations, account reductions and other profit improvement actions made last year are beginning to boost margins, adding that new product launches are scheduled throughout 1997 and 1998.
Alpharma develops and markets specialty generic and proprietary human pharmaceutical and animal health products.
